6455.title: Focused browser routing from global plugin surfaces
6455.rootCauseOneLine: The global URL host cannot see the focused panel's view-scoped browser callback and therefore reports browser unavailability.
6455.proposedFix: Register the existing focused panel opener for the global URL host; preserve scoped callbacks, preference gating and external fallback.
6455.caveats: Native macOS and remote desktop integration were not run; the real React navigation path was reproduced with a stub desktop bridge in two clean trusted checkouts.
